name: Danganronpa: Ultimate Despair Mall
source:
Welcome to Shibasaki Vocational Academy...

"...One of the most prestigious and difficult-to-enter preparatory schools in Japan. The academy teaches only the top, 'Ultimate' students, but not only that — Shibasaki Vocational is a school for exclusively 'Twin-Talented' students, or those with two ultimate talents at once!

The new school year is about to start, and excitement is in the air…

…excitement for killing, as only through the murder of another student and the covering of the heinous act will a student earn their ‘graduation party’! After suddenly finding themselves trapped in a massive shopping mall, the fifteen bright young stars must face their peers with suspicion as unanswered questions hang in the air: Who will make it out under these horrific stipulations? Who will be used as a stepstool for someone else’s own selfish ends? And most importantly, who’s pulling all the strings…?”

[From [url=https://sebmall.itch.io/danganronpa-ultimate-despair-mall]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到柴崎专修学园……

“……这里是日本最负盛名、入学门槛最高的名门升学学校之一。学园不仅只招收最顶尖的‘超高校级的’学生——更特别的是，柴崎专修是一所专门面向‘双才能者’，即同时身怀两项超高校级才能的学生的特殊学府！

新学年即将拉开帷幕，空气中弥漫着兴奋的气息……

……那是属于自相残杀的兴奋——因为唯有亲手杀害另一名同学并完美掩盖这桩滔天罪行，学生才能赢得专属的‘毕业派对’！突如其来地被困在一座庞大的购物中心后，十五颗璀璨的明日之星不得不满怀猜忌地审视身边的同窗，无数悬而未决的疑问在头顶盘旋：在这残酷骇人的规则之下，究竟谁能活着走出去？谁会沦为他人满足私欲的垫脚石？而最关键的是，究竟是谁在幕后操纵着这一切……？”

[摘自[url=https://sebmall.itch.io/danganronpa-ultimate-despair-mall]itch.io[/url]]
